steps.note: A press step's longestUnderMS holds a click to one frame, and on 2026-10-03 it could not see the click: AppKit hands a queued release to the app between two runs of the run loop, the meter ended its pass at the end of a run, and the history filter's switch built its 14 tiles in time nobody counted (about 50ms read as 5.6ms). This walk clicks a history filter with the pointer and holds the main thread 40ms inside the release on purpose: the meter must read at least that, or the guard on every press is blind.
